definition.label: SR-57 Ball Road - screenshot foreground carriageway
definition.notes: Count only the finite screenshot line on the foreground carriageway, from the near verge to the median. Opposing traffic beyond the median and the foreground crossing street are excluded before tracking. Increment only on a confirmed bottom-centre line crossing in capture UTC; a detection or ROI entry alone never counts. Published round definitions and all capture-clock, coverage, framing and tracking checks remain intact.
